# The Instructions

This page is for the man who has prayed the prayer in Chapter 27. If you skipped here, go back. Until the last page your only instructions are to keep reading and to carry on as normal. Chapter 20 gave the method in two lines, decide and rejoice. These eleven spell it out.

1. Follow every instruction. All of them.
2. Keep your mind open.
3. Begin glad. You're being let out, so don't mope.
4. Ignore advice that contradicts this method: streaks, rationing, "moderation".
5. Refuse every stopgap and every substitute. (Plain sense, like the phone out of the bedroom, is neither.)
6. Get it straight: lust gives you no pleasure and no support. You are giving up nothing.
7. Don't wait for a better day. You stopped when you prayed. Stay stopped.
8. You prayed the prayer and said your plain No. Never reopen the question.
9. "Just once" does not exist.
10. Never go back. Not to the porn, not to the hand, and not to the chase.
11. You are fit for service now. Go back for one man, and hand him this book.

## Verses for the moment {-}

EasyPeasy closes with affirmations. We'll use older words. Pick one or two, learn them by heart, and say them aloud when the Little Monster stirs. (If you're not a believer, borrow them anyway. They'll still serve you better than "bye-bye, urges".)

> "For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace."
>
> — Romans 6:14

> "Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."
>
> — James 4:7

> "How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word."
>
> — Psalm 119:9

> "Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me."
>
> — Psalm 51:10

> "Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God."
>
> — Matthew 5:8

> "You are not your own, for you were bought with a price."
>
> — 1 Corinthians 6:19-20

> "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me."
>
> — Philippians 4:13

> "Let's therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need."
>
> — Hebrews 4:16

> "If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed."
>
> — John 8:36

**YES! I'M FREE!**
